what: Maratha general Bhaskar Pant sent a body of armed "Bairagis" toward Bihar; they doubled back to Murshidabad, were looting Baluchar and were driven out by Ali Vardi Khan (1740s). The Maratha raiders are called Bairagis; Vaishnava-ascetic guise, not Daśanāmī.
quote: Bhaskar Pant, the Maratha general, sent a body of armed BairagiB towards Bihar, and All Vardi Khan hastened to follow them.

what: Saidabad residence of Birbhadra (Nityananda's son) noted only in the 24 Parganas volume; here a Jain/Marwari family followed a Bairagi's advice and propitiated Vishnu: one Vaishnava conversion anecdote.
quote: At last he followed the advice of a Bairagi and propitiated Vishnu.
